transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... I guess it's about work. I work retail, and sometimes I have to go into the back stockroom. What brings me in is that the second I even think there might be a bat or something flapping around back there, my heart just jumps. I start sweating immediately, and I just feel like I need to get out right then and there. It's really starting to be a problem.
Does this kind of reaction happen to you in other situations, or is it mostly when you think there might be a bat or something similar in the stockroom?

It's mostly just the bats, or things that look like them. I mean, logically, I know a bat in the store probably isn't going to actually hurt me. But if I see anything that even looks like one, or... or just catch a quick flutter in the back hallway, my mind just treats it like I'm in real danger.
Do you find yourself avoiding going into the stockroom or other areas where you might see a bat, or do you endure those situations with a lot of fear?

Yeah, both, honestly. I try to avoid it whenever I can. I've actually been swapping out my closing shifts lately so I'm not there at night, and... well, I take the long way around the loading area now just to steer clear of the back. 

But when I can't get out of it, like if I absolutely have to check the back stairwell, I just make myself do it as fast as humanly possible. I'll go in holding my phone out, and I'm just feeling pretty scared the whole entire time I'm back there.
When you're not at work or away from the store, do you find yourself worrying a lot about the possibility of encountering a bat in the future?

No, not really. Once I'm away from the store or out of the situations where they usually are, I don't really think about it. It's just when I'm there or in a place where I know they might be that it gets to me. When I'm at home or just out and about, I'm fine.
Have you ever experienced sudden feelings of intense fear, like a panic attack, when you’ve encountered or even thought about something resembling a bat?

I don't think I've ever had an actual panic attack from it. I mean, if I actually see one, or think I see one, my heart definitely starts pounding and I just want to get out of there... but it's not like I can't breathe or anything extreme like that. 

And just thinking about them doesn't really bother me. Like, sitting here talking about it is fine. It's really only when I'm physically in that back room and think one is close by that I get that really strong fear.
How long have you felt this way about bats or things that look like them?
It's been going on for about two years now. It all started since... well, since that night a bat actually got into the back corridor while I was working a receiving shift.
